title: Amplifier Smart Tools / complete orbit loop
intent:
User requests this exact progression. Please author and render it through Unfold; do not substitute another renderer or silently simplify the request. Extend duration to 16 seconds to make time for a complete logo motion cycle. Preserve warm paper #f6f4ee, muted green #486b61, gold #80642f, central 720x720 square crop x280..1000 y0..720, fixed camera, no text. Separate title mark is unchanged.

Corners move independently ALONG their circular track so the shapes change angular spacing and deform as they move. This must not be three rigid squares rotating. All corner markers remain joined to the outline corners and on the circles, with no chord shortcuts. Circle radii can be chosen to match the eventual nested-square logo (about 314,205,98), centered (640,360).
4.5-5s: corners snap with a quick eased convergence to evenly spaced angles, creating three squares. Circle tracks stay fully present through this step.
5-5.5s: circles and construction lines fade ONLY now, leaving the gold nested squares.
5.5-13.5s: perform ONE COMPLETE EIGHT-SECOND cycle of the approved logo motion, fully in gold, without circles. Exact logo rotation sequence for outer/middle/inner squares relative to axis-aligned square: at local0 (0,-8,12) degrees; local2 (-2.5,-16,20); local4 (0,0,0); hold through4.6; local6.3 (2,6,-8); local8 (0,-8,12). 13.5-16s: restore circular tracks and smoothly move the corners back to exact initial irregular geometry. End matches start for seamless looping.
Please solve the irregular connected shapes within your authoring capabilities and inspect frames during deformation, snap, circle fade and logo cycle. The user has seen your earlier irregular shapes and specifically wants this authored by Unfold. Do not claim success if vertices merely rotate together or if disconnected markers only imply a changing outline. If a precise requested behavior cannot be authored, report that specific limitation honestly rather than delivering an unrequested approximation.
Unfold has now been extended with the orbit schema described in the current production guidance. Use closed path elements with orbit:{center:[cx,cy],radius:r,angles:[...],marker_radius:4}, points:[], then orbit_angles tweens for independently moving connected corners. Use marker_opacity to fade markers at logo resolution. Prefer full-canvas path bounds and center [640,360]. The requested deformation is now supported and renderer-tested. Do not use rigid rotation for the irregular phase. For color transition a matching gold orbit path can overlay the green one, using matching angle trajectories while fading opacity. Keep angle lists ordered with positive cyclic gaps; use final evenly spaced angles for squares. Match background circle stroke-center radii with orbit radii. Set duration16 as requested.
context: New 16-second composition continuing the approved circular-track design. Preserve paper, green geometry and gold three-square identity. Use the new orbit authoring controls for true independent vertex motion. Render the complete 16 seconds without compressing the gold cycle.
